entries.reading: Official standard table 1, all64 assignments and RNA alphabet conversion, independently checked against the retained finite wheel data. Alternate organism/organelle tables are not asserted equivalent.

Skinner2008 original review: prenatal F0 exposure directly reaches F1 embryo and prospective F2 germ line; F3 is the first unexposed generation in that scenario. Adult germ-cell exposure has a different generation boundary. This supports generation logic only, not clinical effects or demonstrated inherited methylation in the constructed plant case.

Crum et al1988 actual primary abstract includes antisense DNA oligomers and their RNA analogues in a cell-free TMV translation model. Complementarity and hybridisation affect inhibition, with sense controls. The source supports the bounded RNA-complementarity translation mechanism; no efficacy, patient result, delivery success or obligatory RNA degradation is inferred.
